text:
maya: Quick gap-triage before GA: we still need final SLA wording for edge cases, a private-deploy friction doc, monitoring alert owners, and confirmation on burst-credit expiry. Please ack ownership.

eli: I'll do SLA wording. Plan: short lead-in + matrix by model family. Need to confirm max_input_tokens cutoffs. ETA Wed.

sophia: I'll write the private-deploy friction doc (common pitfalls + KMS snippet + enforcement example). ETA Thu AM.

noah: Monitoring: I'll create alerts for p99 regressions (+20% over baseline, 10m) and per-route cost spikes (+40% 10m). Will attach runbooks. ETA Fri noon.

maya: Burst credits decision: offer 1M-token pilot window; finance/legal want explicit expiry language.

finance-bot: We'll require a clause: "pilot credits expire with 30 days' notice" and an example calculation for how credits are consumed. ETA Thu.

eli: SLA caveat: exclude non-verified and >1024-token requests. I'll draft language and post for legal review.

sophia: I'll surface that caveat as a banner in the quickstart + example config that caps requests.

maya: Acceptance checklist to gate GA: SLA text reviewed, docs merged, monitoring alerts live, burst-credit clause approved. Reply "ack + ETA".

sophia: ack Thu AM.

eli: ack Wed EOD.

noah: ack Fri noon.

finance-bot: ack Thu EOD.
